name: Thibela pelehi
tagline: Dikgetho tsa hao. Ke eng mahala. Se loketseng bophelo ba hao.
reviewer: Ho hlahloba ha tleliniki ho ntse ho emetse

what_is_it.heading: Thibela pelehi ka mantsoe a hlakileng
what_is_it.lede: Thibela pelehi e u fa monyetla oa ho khetha hore na u na le bana neng le haeba u e-na le bana. Afrika Boroa e fana ka mefuta e mengata ea mekhoa - boholo ba eona ke mahala litleliniking tsa mmuso. Mekhoa e fapaneng e lumellana le bophelo bo fapaneng.
paragraphs: Ha ho na mokhoa o "molemo ka ho fetisisa" - ke o loketseng feela hona joale. Khetho e itšetlehile ka lilemo tsa hau, bophelo bo botle, merero ea bana, boemo ba molekane le mokhoa oa bophelo. Mokhoa o nepahetseng ke oo u tla o sebelisa kamehla.

Litliliniki tsohle tsa mmuso li fana ka lithibela-pelehi mahala. Ha ho hlokahale hore u kenyelle molekane oa hau, batsoali (ho tloha lilemong tse 12), kapa mang kapa mang. Lekunutu le sirelelitsoe ke molao oa Afrika Boroa - basebeletsi ba tsa bophelo bo botle ba ke ke ba arolelana khetho ea hau ea thibelo ea bokhachane ntle le tumello ea hau.

facts.heading: Lintho tse 'nè tseo u lokelang ho li tseba

items.headline: Tsohle mahala
items.body: Lipilisi, liente, li-implant, li-IUD, likhohlopo - kaofela li fumaneha mahala tleliniking e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea 'muso.

items.headline: Likhetho tse ngata
items.body: Lipilisi tsa letsatsi le letsatsi, liente tsa khoeli le khoeli, liente tsa khoeli le khoeli tse 3, li-implants tse nkang lilemo tse 3, li-IUD tse nkang lilemo tse 10.

items.headline: Lekunutu
items.body: Ho tloha dilemong tse 12 o ka fihlella dithibelapelehi ka lekunutu. Basebeletsi ba tsa bophelo bo botle ba ke ke ba bolella batsoali kapa balekane ntle le tumello ea hau.

items.headline: Pilisi ea tšohanyetso
items.body: Morning-after pill e sebetsa ho fihlela matsatsi a 5 ka mor'a thobalano - empa kapele e ba betere. E fumaneha mahala litleliniking, e fumaneha likhemising tse ngata.

pull_quote.text: Ke likhohlopo feela tse sireletsang boimana le mafu a likobo. Mekhoa ea li-hormone e sebetsa haholo bakeng sa bokhachane empa ha e fane ka tšireletso khahlanong le tšoaetso. Eketsa habeli ha u khona.

signs.heading: Ke mokhoa ofe o lumellanang le bophelo ba hau?
signs.lede: Ha ho karabo e le 'ngoe e nepahetseng. Bapisa mokhoa le bophelo ba hau - 'me u hopole hore u ka fetola nako efe kapa efe.

items.title: Batla nako e telele, boikitlaetso bo fokolang
items.description: Ho kenngoa (lilemo tse 3, molamu o monyenyane letsohong le ka holimo) kapa IUD (lilemo tse 3-10 ho itšetlehile ka mofuta). Ka bobeli li sebetsa hantle haholo 'me u ka li lebala hang ha li se li le teng.

items.title: Batla taolo ea khoeli le khoeli
items.description: Pilisi (e nooa letsatsi le leng le le leng ka nako e le 'ngoe) kapa ente (khoeli le khoeli kapa 3-khoeli). Ho molemo haeba u ka batla ho ima selemong se tlang kapa tse peli.

items.title: U batla tšireletso ea mafu a likobo hape
items.description: Likhohlopo tsa banna kapa tsa basali - nako le nako, ka lithibela-pelehi tse ling kapa ntle ho tsona. Ke tsona feela tse sireletsang khahlanong le HIV le mafu a likobo.

myths.heading: Seo eleng nnete le seo eseng sona

items.myth: Thibela pelehi e baka ho hloka thari hamorao.
items.fact: Mekhoa eohle e ka fetoloang e etsa hore tsoalo ea hau e khutle kamora ho emisa - hangata ka mor'a likhoeli. Ha ho na phello ea nako e telele ea ho ba le bana hamorao ha u ba batla.

items.myth: U ke ke ua ima ka lekhetlo la pele, kapa ha u anyesa.
items.fact: O ka kgona ka botlalo. Kamehla sebelisa lithibela-pelehi haeba u sa batle ho ima - lekhetlo la pele, ho ea khoeling, kapa nako efe kapa efe ka mor'a tsoalo.

items.myth: Pilisi e sireletsa khahlanong le HIV le mafu a likobo.
items.fact: Thibela pelehi ea li-hormone e thibela ho ima feela. Bakeng sa mafu a likobo le HIV - likhohlopo nako le nako, kapa PrEP haeba e le kotsing e kholo ea HIV.

items.myth: Thibela pelehi ea tšohanyetso e tšoana le ho ntša mpa.
items.fact: Thibela pelehi ea tšohanyetso e sebetsa pele bokhachane bo qala - e liehisa ho hlahisa mahe. E ke ke ea felisa bokhachane bo teng. Ho felisoa ha bokhachane ke tšebeletso e ikemetseng, ea molao.

items.title: E-ea tleliniking efe kapa efe ea mmuso
items.description: Kena. Kopa lithibela-pelehi. Ba tla u hlalosetsa likhetho 'me ba u thuse ho khetha. Ha ho hlokahale kopano, ha ho hlokahale thuso ea bongaka.

items.title: Leka mokhoa - 'me u fetole haeba o sa lumellane
items.description: Litla-morao ka mokhoa o le mong ha li bolele hore tse ling li tla u fa mathata. Basali ba bangata ba leka 2 kapa 3 pele ba fumana e nepahetseng. Ho fetola ke mahala.

items.title: Haeba u hloloheloa pilisi - hlahloba pampitšana
items.description: Lipilisi tse fapaneng li na le melao e fapaneng. Ka kakaretso: noa lipilisi tse fetiloeng hang ha u hopola, 'me u sebelise likhohlopo matsatsi a 7 e le bekapo.

items.title: Haeba thobalano ntle le tšireletso e etsahala
items.description: Thibela pelehi ea tšohanyetso nakong ea matsatsi a 5. Mahala litliliniking. R30–80 likhemising tse ngata. Kapele ho molemo. Ha e nkele lithibela-pelehi tse tloaelehileng.

items.title: Banyalani - leka ho etsa qeto hammoho
items.description: Thibela pelehi e sebetsa hantle ha balekane ka bobeli ba tšehetsa khetho. Litliliniki tse ngata li fana ka tlhabollo ho banyalani. Liphetho li betere ha le le leqepheng le le leng.

get_help.heading: Moo u ka eang teng
get_help.lede: Thibela pelehi ke e 'ngoe ea litšebeletso tsa bophelo bo botle ba sechaba tse hlophisitsoeng hantle tsa Afrika Boroa. E mahala, e lekunutu, e fumaneha ho motho e mong le e mong ho tloha ho lilemo tse 12.

helplines.name: Fumana tleliniki e haufi le uena
helplines.description: Tleliniki e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea 'muso e fana ka lithibela-pelehi le tlhabollo mahala
helplines.meta: Ha ho kopano · ha ho hlokahale thuso ea bongaka · lilemo tse 12+
